title.zh-CN: 肢端凉与手指僵硬 · 16岁7个月女孩
title.en: Cold extremities and stiff fingers · girl aged 16 years 7 months

summary.zh-CN: 长期肢端症状逐渐出现皮肤硬化和指端组织损伤，需评估多器官证据和治疗风险。
summary.en: Longstanding acral symptoms progress to skin tightening and digital tissue injury; assess multi-organ evidence and treatment risks.

name.zh-CN: 皮肤肌肉病理及既往疗效

zh-CN: 皮肤肌肉病理及既往疗效

text.zh-CN: 皮肤活检与硬皮病样改变相符，肌肉明显变性伴血管扩张。糖皮质激素、免疫球蛋白、环磷酰胺及甲氨蝶呤治疗后，雷诺和僵硬无明显改善。
text.en: Skin biopsy supported scleroderma-like change and muscle showed marked degeneration with vascular dilatation. Raynaud symptoms and stiffness showed no clear improvement after corticosteroids, immunoglobulin, cyclophosphamide and methotrexate.

text.zh-CN: 报告加用两次利妥昔单抗后雷诺改善、拇指坏死未继续加重，ANA及nRNP转阴；表1加用RTX后B淋巴计数0.00、ENA及nRNP阴性，但CRP9.5 mg/L、血小板123×10⁹/L且胸片仍有间质改变。随访1年未报告过敏感染，远期疗效安全仍不确定。
text.en: After two rituximab administrations the report described improved Raynaud symptoms, no progression of thumb necrosis, and negative ANA/anti-nRNP. After RTX, Table 1 records B-cell count 0.00 and negative ENA/nRNP, but CRP 9.5 mg/L, platelets 123×10⁹/L and persistent interstitial chest-film changes. No allergy/infection was reported over one year; long-term efficacy and safety remained uncertain.

prompt.zh-CN: 哪种解释更能覆盖临床与抗体结果？
prompt.en: Which interpretation best covers the clinical and antibody evidence?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 混合结缔组织病方向，需持续评估缺血及肺等器官受累
text.en: A mixed-connective-tissue-disease pattern requiring ongoing ischaemic and organ assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 雷诺、硬皮样改变、肌肉和肺线索与高滴度nRNP共同构成综合证据。
feedback.en: Raynaud, scleroderma-like features, muscle/lung clues and high anti-RNP form integrated evidence.

text.zh-CN: 原发雷诺可解释全部组织坏死与抗体结果
text.en: Primary Raynaud phenomenon explains all necrosis and antibodies

feedback.zh-CN: 组织坏死、多器官异常和自身抗体支持继发性系统性病变评估。
feedback.en: Necrosis, multi-organ findings and antibodies prompt assessment of a secondary systemic disorder.

text.zh-CN: CRP正常足以排除活动性结缔组织病
text.en: Normal CRP excludes active connective-tissue disease

feedback.zh-CN: CRP不是这组疾病活动的唯一标志，不能抹去临床器官损伤。
feedback.en: CRP is not the sole activity marker and cannot negate clinical organ injury.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 治疗无效与组织改变提示重评病程；CK标记需结合参考范围
text.en: Non-response and tissue changes warrant reassessment; the CK flag needs its reference range

feedback.zh-CN: 原文CK 56被称升高而参考区间缺失，不能自造严重肌酶增高。
feedback.en: CK 56 is labelled raised without a range; marked enzyme elevation must not be invented.

text.zh-CN: ANA转阴即可定义临床治愈
text.en: Negative ANA alone defines clinical cure

feedback.zh-CN: 局部灌注、器官功能及长期结局仍须随访。
feedback.en: Perfusion, organ function and long-term outcomes still require follow-up.

text.zh-CN: 硬皮病样活检排除所有其他结缔组织病表现
text.en: Scleroderma-like biopsy excludes all other connective-tissue features

feedback.zh-CN: 病理是一部分证据，不能覆盖混合临床表型。
feedback.en: Histology is one part of the evidence and does not erase a mixed clinical phenotype.

prompt.zh-CN: 对难治性病程和生物制剂应如何决策？
prompt.en: How should refractory disease and biologic therapy be approached?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 风湿专科重新评估指端缺血、器官风险和感染筛查，在知情讨论下制定个体化方案
text.en: Specialist reassessment of digital ischaemia, organ risk and infection screening with an individualised informed treatment plan

feedback.zh-CN: 报告生物制剂后的改善可供讨论，但不足以保证疗效和远期安全。
feedback.en: Improvement after a biologic in the report informs discussion but cannot guarantee efficacy or long-term safety.

text.zh-CN: 该单例证明利妥昔单抗是所有患儿的固定首选
text.en: This case proves rituximab is the fixed first choice for every child

feedback.zh-CN: 单例、联合治疗和有限随访无法建立普适疗效。
feedback.en: One case, concomitant therapies and limited follow-up cannot establish universal efficacy.

text.zh-CN: 只追踪抗体转阴即可，不需要评估指端坏死
text.en: Track antibody negativity alone without reassessing digital necrosis

feedback.zh-CN: 抗体不能替代组织灌注、器官功能和安全监测。
feedback.en: Antibodies do not replace assessment of tissue perfusion, organ function and safety.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：多器官表现比单一抗体更重要。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：体重、完整感染筛查、CK参考范围、长期肺功能和远期生物制剂安全性。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: The multi-organ pattern matters more than a single antibody. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Weight, complete infection screening, CK reference range, long-term lung function and biologic safety. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 报告诊断难治性儿童混合结缔组织病；指端坏死及肺线索要求持续器官和安全评估。
conclusion.en: The report diagnosed refractory childhood mixed connective tissue disease; digital necrosis and lung findings require continued organ and safety assessment.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 多器官表现比单一抗体更重要。
keyReasoning.en: The multi-organ pattern matters more than a single antibody.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 正常CRP不能否定严重指端病变。
keyReasoning.en: Normal CRP does not negate serious digital disease.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 治疗前后变化不能确立单项疗法的因果效果。
keyReasoning.en: Before/after change cannot establish one therapy’s causal effect.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 联系雷诺、皮肤硬化及肺肌肉改变。
teachingPoints.en: Connect Raynaud, skin sclerosis and lung/muscle findings.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 为未列参考范围的肌酶保留解释限制。
teachingPoints.en: Retain interpretation limits for enzymes without reference ranges.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 把患者安全及长期功能放在抗体变化之前。
teachingPoints.en: Prioritise safety and long-term function over antibody changes.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 体重、完整感染筛查、CK参考范围、长期肺功能和远期生物制剂安全性。
unknowns.en: Weight, complete infection screening, CK reference range, long-term lung function and biologic safety.
